children: Progressive reported August net income of $951 million and net premiums written of $7.61 billion, with a combined ratio of 89.3.

Net income $951M for the month, down 22% vs. August 2025; diluted EPS $1.63, down 21%.
Total net realized gains on securities $108M in August, increasing investment contribution 38% YoY.
August combined ratio 89.3 (up 6.2 pts YoY); loss/LAE ratio 68.8 and expense ratio 20.5.
